main_text.p: ter, & ex hujus dedifcenda di- fciplina minutuli vitilitigato- res, qui putridam illam cram- bem recoquere, delicias fuas facere, redempto Christi po- pulo fidenter apponere aufi, auri nefcio quid in obfoleto- rum hujufmodi commento- rum ftercoribus, quod cum fructu quæri & facile inveniri poffet, latere tam falfo, quam infœliciter garrirent. Ho- rum Sophiftice à Christi fervis fæpius confutata, aureoloque, qui nunc Latine prodit, libel- lo pro merito excepta, adeo inter noftrates eviluit, ut pue- ris ipfis ac mulierculis, vel le- viter Christiana doctrina im- butis, ludibrium debeat, & ad exteros transfugere coacta fit.

page.notes: Scan shows a printed page with a faint reference mark "*" beside the page number "4". Some letters are blurred by show-through and stains; readings such as "fidenter", "Sophiftice", "aureoloque" and "nefcio" are as read from the scan and may be uncertain. The line "Si" at the foot right is taken as a catchword.
